name: Sagar Bera
title: Founding Engineer (Backend & DevOps)
headline: Founding backend and DevOps engineer. I build and run the systems behind products used by 50,000+ creators.
bio: I'm a founding engineer at Scribble Network, where I own the backend and infrastructure end to end: [[NestJS]] APIs, [[PostgreSQL]] schemas, and the [[Docker]], [[CI/CD]], and cloud setup that keeps them running. I moved our core data from MongoDB to PostgreSQL, and what I've built now serves [[50,000+]] creators and helped one client grow AI citation share from [[2% to 20%]] in 3 months. Before that, at BuidlersTribe, I rebuilt a Drupal site on [[MERN]] and sped up feature delivery by [[30%]].

experience.summary: Joined early and grew with the company. I own backend, database design, and infrastructure across Scribble's creator, brand, and ad products on [[AWS]] and [[GCP]].
highlights: Moved core data from MongoDB to [[PostgreSQL]] for cleaner structure and faster queries, which made new features far easier to add.
Set up production infrastructure that handles [[100–300]] API requests per second for [[1.5k–2k]] daily active users.
Automated production deployments with GitHub Actions and set up log monitoring with Loki and Grafana.

Built Scribble for Creators ([[50,000+]] creators, [[$500,000+]] paid across [[800+]] campaigns), Scribble for Brands (Listed in Product Hunt's [[Top 3 AI Products of the Week]]), and Kili ([[250+]] daily active developers currently using the platform).
Built auth system from scratch: [[Magic links]] plus [[Google]] and [[X (Twitter)]] login.
Built [[Microservices]] for notifications and incoming webhooks, and a faucet that handles crypto payouts.
Built a crypto native Telegram that lets anyone [[send crypto]] using just a Telegram username.
Built Rabots: one-click bots that put funds into [[DeFi yield]], so beginners skip the usual research and multi-step setup.
Wrote Smart Contracts in [[Solidity]] for EVM and [[Move]] for Sui to handle prediction markets and automated trading.
Leveraged Cursor and Claude Code every day to ship faster.

experience.summary: Rebuilt BuidlersTribe's Drupal (LAMP) website as a [[MERN]] app, trading Drupal's limited built-in settings for a codebase we could fully customize.
highlights: Led the Drupal to MERN migration, which made the product easy to customize and sped up feature delivery by [[30%]].
Used the new stack to rebrand with a cleaner, easier-to-use interface, which grew product traction and pushed daily active users up.
Deployed and ran the app on [[AWS]] behind Nginx.
